18173-tales-of-the-ridings.title: Tales Of The Ridings
18173-tales-of-the-ridings.creator: F. W. Moorman 1872 - 1919
18173-tales-of-the-ridings.description: A book by F. W. Moorman 1872 - 1919. hardly so beautiful as that which he had left and whose memory he never ceased to cherish. But it has a charm all its own, and the child of Dartmoor had no great reason to lament his removal to the grey uplands and "golden valleys" of the Cotswolds.

73128-a-history-of-criticism-and-literar.title: _From The Earliest Texts To The Present Day_
73128-a-history-of-criticism-and-literar.creator: Unknown
73128-a-history-of-criticism-and-literar.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. no apology, for what may seem to some the surprisingly large space given to English critics. That the book itself is intended primarily for English readers would be but a poor-spirited plea; and the greatness of English literature as a whole, though a worthier, is still an unnecessary argument.

arxiv-1910-10296.title: On Topological Properties of Planar Octahedron Networks
arxiv-1910-10296.creator: Haidar Ali, Farzana Kousar
arxiv-1910-10296.description: Abstract Topological indices are scientific details of graphs which represents its topology and of the most part graph invariant. In QSAR/QSPR, physico-chemical characteristics and topological indices, for example, atom bond connectivity ( A ​ B ​ C ) (ABC) and geometric-arithmetic ( G ​ A ) (GA) indices are apply to foresee the bioactivity of concoction mixes.

arxiv-2012-15697.title: Interactive SARS-CoV-2 mutation timemaps
arxiv-2012-15697.creator: René L. Warren, Inanç Birol
arxiv-2012-15697.description: Abstract As the year 2020 draws to an end, several new strains have been reported for the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus, the agent responsible for the COVID-19 pandemic that has afflicted us all this past year. However, it is difficult to comprehend the scale, in sequence space, geographical location and time, at which SARS-CoV-2 mutates and evolves in its human hosts.

arxiv-2111-03212.title: An overview of event extraction and its applications
arxiv-2111-03212.creator: Jiangwei Liu, Liangyu Min, Xiaohong Huang
arxiv-2111-03212.description: Abstract With the rapid development of information technology, online platforms have produced enormous text resources. As a particular form of Information Extraction (IE), Event Extraction (EE) has gained increasing popularity due to its ability to automatically extract events from human language. However, there are limited literature surveys on event extraction.

arxiv-2212-14498.title: The deformation of an erupting magnetic flux rope in a confined solar flare
arxiv-2212-14498.creator: Ruisheng Zheng, Yihan Liu, Liang Zhang, Yang Liu, Changhui Rao, Qing Lin, Zhimao Du, Libo Zhong, Huadong Chen, Yao Chen
arxiv-2212-14498.description: Abstract Magnetic flux ropes (MFRs), sets of coherently twisted magnetic field lines, are believed as core structures of various solar eruptions. Their evolution plays an important role to understand the physical mechanisms of solar eruptions, and can shed light on adverse space weather near the Earth.

arxiv-2308-02004.title: The Quest for the Nature of the Dark Matter: The Need of a New Paradigm
arxiv-2308-02004.creator: Fabrizio Nesti, Paolo Salucci, Nicola Turini
arxiv-2308-02004.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fabrizio Nesti, Paolo Salucci, Nicola Turini. The phenomenon of the Dark matter baffles the researchers: the underlying dark particle has escaped so far the detection and its astrophysical role appears complex and entangled with that of the standard luminous particles. We propose that, in order to act efficiently, alongside with abandoning the current Λ ​ C ​ D ​ M \Lambda CDM scenario, we need also to shift the Paradigm from which it emerged.

arxiv-2310-15951.title: Weighted Distance Nearest Neighbor Condensing
arxiv-2310-15951.creator: Lee-Ad Gottlieb, Timor Sharabi, Roi Weiss
arxiv-2310-15951.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lee-Ad Gottlieb, Timor Sharabi, Roi Weiss. The problem of nearest neighbor condensing has enjoyed a long history of study, both in its theoretical and practical aspects. In this paper, we introduce the problem of weighted distance nearest neighbor condensing, where one assigns weights to each point of the condensed set, and then new points are labeled based on their weighted distance nearest neighbor in the condensed set.

arxiv-2404-13456.title: Real-Time Safe Control of Neural Network Dynamic Models with Sound Approximation
arxiv-2404-13456.creator: Hanjiang Hu, Jianglin Lan, Changliu Liu
arxiv-2404-13456.description: Abstract Safe control of neural network dynamic models (NNDMs) is important to robotics and many applications. However, it remains challenging to compute an optimal safe control in real time for NNDM. To enable real-time computation, we propose to use a sound approximation of the NNDM in the control synthesis.

arxiv-2411-18961.title: The Fefferman Metric for Twistor CR Manifolds and Conformal Geodesics in Dimension Three
arxiv-2411-18961.creator: Taiji MARUGAME
arxiv-2411-18961.description: Abstract We give an explicit description of the Fefferman metric for twistor CR manifolds in terms of Riemannian structures on the base conformal 3 3 -manifolds. As an application, we prove that chains and null chains on twistor CR manifolds project to conformal geodesics, and that any conformal geodesic has lifts both to a chain and a null chain.

arxiv-2412-14980.title: Local solubility of ternary cubic forms
arxiv-2412-14980.creator: Golo Wolff
arxiv-2412-14980.description: Abstract We consider cubic forms ϕ a , b ​ ( x , y , z ) = a ​ x 3 + b ​ y 3 − z 3 \phi_{a,b}(x,y,z)=ax^{3}+by^{3}-z^{3} with coefficients a , b ∈ Z a,b\in\mathbb{Z} . We give an asymptotic formula for how many of these forms are locally soluble everywhere, i.e.

arxiv-2504-21566.title: Rendering LaTeX in R
arxiv-2504-21566.creator: by Paul Murrell
arxiv-2504-21566.description: Abstract The xdvir package provides functions for rendering LaTeX fragments as labels, annotations, and data symbols in R plots. There are convenient high-level functions for rendering LaTeX fragments, including labels on ggplot2 plots, plus lower-level functions for more fine control over the separate authoring, typesetting, and rendering steps. There is support for making use of LaTeX packages, including TikZ graphics.

arxiv-2506-01092.title: BWT for string collections
arxiv-2506-01092.creator: Davide Cenzato, Zsuzsanna Lipták, Nadia Pisanti, Giovanna Rosone, Marinella Sciortino
arxiv-2506-01092.description: Abstract We survey the different methods used for extending the BWT to collections of strings, following largely [Cenzato and Lipták, CPM 2022, Bioinformatics 2024]. We analyze the specific aspects and combinatorial properties of the resulting BWT variants and give a categorization of publicly available tools for computing the BWT of string collections.

arxiv-2508-09209.title: Quantum-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Networks: Comparative Analysis of Classical and Hybrid Quantum–Classical Generative Adversarial Networks
arxiv-2508-09209.creator: Kun Ming Goh
arxiv-2508-09209.description: Abstract Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for producing high-fidelity data samples, yet their performance is constrained by the quality of latent representations, typically sampled from classical noise distributions. This study investigates hybrid quantum–classical GANs (HQCGANs) in which a quantum generator, implemented via parameterised quantum circuits, produces latent vectors for a classical discriminator.

arxiv-2511-07814.title: Superspecial primes for QM abelian surfaces over real number fields
arxiv-2511-07814.creator: Fangu Chen fangu@berkeley.edu
arxiv-2511-07814.description: Abstract . Baba and Granath generalize Elkies’ theorem on infinitude of supersingular primes for elliptic curves to abelian surfaces with quaternionic multiplication of discriminant 6 6 , whose field of moduli is ℚ \mathbb{Q} and which is a Jacobian in characteristic 2 2 and 3 3 .

arxiv-2512-11762.title: The Relative Monadic Metalanguage DOI: 10.1145/3776702 Journal: PACMPL Volume: 10 POPL 60 1 CCS: Theory of computation Categorical semantics
arxiv-2512-11762.creator: Jack Liell-Cock, Zev Shirazi, Sam Staton
arxiv-2512-11762.description: Abstract . Relative monads provide a controlled view of computation. We generalise the monadic metalanguage to a relative setting and give a complete semantics with strong relative monads. Adopting this perspective, we generalise two existing program calculi from the literature.

arxiv-2604-22285.creator: Xiaofeng Zhou ∗ , Linfeng Du ∗ , Guangyu Hu ∗ , Sharad Sinha † , Hongce Zhang § , Wei Zhang ∗

arxiv-2606-03075.creator: Jizhihui Liu, Ruizi Han, Miao Zhang †, Rui Shao, Xuebo Liu, Weili Guan, Yaowei Wang

britannica-1911-della-quercia-jacopo.title: Della Quercia, Jacopo (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-della-quercia-jacopo.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-della-quercia-jacopo.description: Article 'Della Quercia, Jacopo' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Italian sculptor, was born at Siena. He was the son of a goldsmith of repute, Pietro d’Agnolo, to whom he doubtless owed much of his training. There are no records of his early life until the year 1394, when he made an equestrian statue of Gian Tedesco.

doe-osti-3401580-intelligent-experiments.title: Intelligent Experiments Through Real-time AI: Fast Data Processing and Autonomous Detector Control for sPHENIX and Future EIC Detectors (Final Report)
doe-osti-3401580-intelligent-experiments.creator: Roland, Gunther, Dean, Cameron, Bossi, Hannah et al.
doe-osti-3401580-intelligent-experiments.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The overall vision of this project was to integrate real-time artificial intelligence (AI) directly into the data acquisition and detector-control systems of nuclear physics experiments, including both fast online event selection and an autonomous detector-control feedback loop.

plos-pone-0355503.title: Research on the vessel passing capacity of the Changshan waterway
plos-pone-0355503.creator: Rui Sun, Lvzhen Ren, Wen Ma, Luling Zeng
plos-pone-0355503.description: Research on the vessel passing capacity of the Changshan waterway

pmc-10539770.title: The effect of propolis addition to the laying-hen diet on performance, serum lipid profile and liver fat rate
pmc-10539770.creator: Şaziye Canan Bölükbaşı, Hilal Ürüşan, Betül Apaydın Yıldırım
pmc-10539770.description: The aim of this study was to evaluate the effect of propolis (P) on performance, egg quality parameters, serum lipid profile, some liver enzymes and liver fat ratio. One-hundred-and-twenty Lohmann (LSL) laying hens were divided into five groups, and each group consisted of six subgroups. The control group was fed basal diet.

pmc-10669507.title: Phytochemicals Target Multiple Metabolic Pathways in Cancer
pmc-10669507.creator: Oleg Shuvalov, Yulia Kirdeeva, Alexandra Daks, Olga Fedorova, Sergey Parfenyev, Hans-Uwe Simon, Nickolai A. Barlev
pmc-10669507.description: Cancer metabolic reprogramming is a complex process that provides malignant cells with selective advantages to grow and propagate in the hostile environment created by the immune surveillance of the human organism. This process underpins cancer proliferation, invasion, antioxidant defense, and resistance to anticancer immunity and therapeutics.

pmc-10716739.title: Carbon amendments in soil microcosms induce uneven response on H2 oxidation activity and microbial community composition
pmc-10716739.creator: Xavier Baril, Philippe Constant
pmc-10716739.description: High-affinity H2-oxidizing bacteria (HA-HOB) thriving in soil are responsible for the most important sink of atmospheric H2. Their activity increases with soil organic carbon content, but the incidence of different carbohydrate fractions on the process has received little attention. Here we tested the hypothesis that carbon amendments impact HA-HOB activity and diversity differentially depending on their recalcitrance and their concentration.

pmc-11357917.title: Re-examining the role of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation in relapsed large B-cell lymphoma in the era of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy
pmc-11357917.creator: Tamara K. Moyo, Rakhee Vaidya
pmc-11357917.description: Historically, salvage chemoimmunotherapy with consolidative autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (ASCT) was the only potentially curative therapeutic option for patients with relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL). Treatment options were few and outcomes poor for patients whose lymphoma failed to respond to salvage chemotherapy/ASCT and for patients not eligible for ASCT.

pmc-11458971.title: Reduced WNT4 expression in normal skin fibroblasts leads to ‘Dupuytren-like’ changes in the transcriptome
pmc-11458971.creator: Aoife O'Brien, Andrew Stevenson, Lucy Barrett, Nicholas B. Lawler, Nicole Hortin, Zhenjun Deng, Amira Allahham, Fabio Quondamatteo, Nicole Smith, K. Swaminathan Iyer, Fiona M. Wood, Mark W. Fear
pmc-11458971.description: BackgroundDupuytren's disease (DD) is a fibro-proliferative disorder of unknown aetiology. Previous studies have implicated multiple WNT signalling genes/proteins in Dupuytren pathology, including WNT4. However, it is not yet clear whether WNT signalling dysregulation plays an important role in the initiation of the disease or progression.

pmc-11461957.title: Tunable multistate field-free switching and ratchet effect by spin-orbit torque in canted ferrimagnetic alloy
pmc-11461957.creator: Cheng-Hsiang Hsu, Miela J. Gross, Hannah Calzi Kleidermacher, Shehrin Sayed, Sayeef Salahuddin
pmc-11461957.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Spin-orbit torque is not only a useful probe to study manipulation of magnetic textures and magnetic states at the nanoscale but also it carries great potential for next-generation computing applications. Here we report the observation of rich spin-orbit torque switching phenomena such as field-free switching, multistate switching, memristor behavior and ratchet effect in a single shot, co-sputtered, rare earth-transition metal GdxCo100−x. Notably such effects have only been observed in antiferromagnet/ferromagnet bi-layer systems previously.

pmc-11642840.title: Prevalence of Oral Diseases and the Influence of the Presence of Overweight/Obesity in Schoolchildren Population in Mallorca
pmc-11642840.creator: Irene Coll, Daniela Vallejos, Raúl Cuesta, Jorge Domínguez, Pilar Tomás, Nora López-Safont, Agostino Guida
pmc-11642840.description: Background: The pediatric population is one of the social groups most affected by oral pathology, and overweight and/or obesity is increasingly frequently observed. This work presents a study of the prevalence of oral disease in the school population in Mallorca and its relationship with overweight/obesity.

pmc-12375536.title: Development of a Domestic Alternative Positive Control Strain to Bacillus cereus ATCC 14579 for Microbial Assays
pmc-12375536.creator: Su-Hyeon Joung, Yu-Si Lee, Byeong Joon Kim, Yongchjun Park, Seung Hwan Kim, Soon Han Kim, Insun Joo, Eun Sook An
pmc-12375536.description: Most positive control strains in microbial assays are sourced from abroad. Bacillus cereus ATCC 14579 is used as the positive control strain in microbial assays described in the Manual for the Detection of Foodborne Pathogens at Outbreaks and the FDA’s Bacteriological Analytical Manual method.

pmc-12417326.title: Atypical Presentation of Metastasis of Appendiceal Cancer: Neoplastic Growth Infiltrating an Inguinal Hernia
pmc-12417326.creator: Peter Mounas, Tony Elias, Amit Kharod, Nikolette Zamarra
pmc-12417326.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Although rare, appendiceal cancer can metastasize to unusual sites, including the inguinal canal. In patients with a history of abdominal malignancy presenting with an inguinal hernia, metastatic disease should be considered for adequate recognition and early oncologic intervention.Keywords: chronic diseases, gastroenterology/hepatology, oncology, surgery

Although uncommon, appendiceal cancer has shown an increasing incidence over the past three decades, necessitating further clinical awareness. The rarity of the diagnosis and its ambiguous presentations can significantly hinder the ability to recognize it in clinical practice.

pmc-12686410.title: Heterogeneity of active mast cells, endothelial cells, and fibroblasts in hemophilic arthritis defined by synovial single-cell sequencing
pmc-12686410.creator: Kun Lin, Shuai Fan, Xiaoqiang Yang, Wenyuan Hou, Junjiao Zhang, Jiaru Liao, Longfei Han, Peng Peng, Fangjun Xiao, Weihua Fang, Xianshun He, Jiaqing Tian, Shun Lu, Fan Yang, Qiushi Wei, Mincong He
pmc-12686410.description: Recurrent synovial bleeding is the major cause of Hemophilic Arthritis (HA). Up to now, the transcriptomic profiles of bleeding syvonium in HA patient have largely remained unknown. Exploring the transcriptomic characteristics of synovium obtained from HA patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty (TKA), and uncovering potential pathological mechanisms of HA synovium through bioinformatics analysis and differential analysis.

pmc-12961849.title: CRISPR/Cas9-mediated B2m knockout paves the way for allogeneic basal cell transplantation
pmc-12961849.creator: Huanjie Chen, Weizhan Luo, Ning Ma, Shiyue Li
pmc-12961849.description: BackgroundAutologous transplantation of basal cells (BCs) has shown promise in treating respiratory diseases, but disease-specific subpopulations among BCs probably diminish the treatment efficacy. An alternative approach involves generating universal and healthy BCs, which offers a potentially more efficient and accessible solution for avoiding using abnormal BCs.

pmc-13026994.title: Functional Characterization of OasiCSP12: A Chemosensory Protein Regulating Olfaction and Phase Change in Oedaleus decorus asiaticus
pmc-13026994.creator: Shu Xu, Wenchang Duan, Huijuan Shi, Yajing Cai, Yaojie Zheng, Haibin Han, Ling Li, Yanyan Li, Yu Zhang
pmc-13026994.description: Simple SummaryOedaleus decorus asiaticus is a major grassland pest whose outbreaks are driven by density-dependent phase change, a process mediated through chemical communication. This study suggests that a chemosensory protein, OasiCSP12, may participate in this process. OasiCSP12 shows phase- and sex-specific expression, with predominant levels in the antennae of gregarious adults.

pmc-13249249.title: Recombinant human type-5 adenovirus (H101) combined with radiofrequency ablation versus traditional radiofrequency ablation for hepatocellular carcinoma ≤3 cm: a phase III randomized controlled trial
pmc-13249249.creator: Hai-Su Dai, Zhi-Peng Liu, Hua-Qiang Bi, De-Hong Tan, Yu-Le Luo, Xian-Yu Yin, Yi Gong, Kuan-Sheng Ma, Zhi-Yu Chen, Kai Feng
pmc-13249249.description: Background:Radiofrequency ablation (RFA) is standard for small hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet recurrence remains common. This phase III trial compared RFA combined with recombinant human type-5 adenovirus (H101) versus traditional RFA in HCC ≤3 cm.Methods:This study prospectively collected data from patients between 2018 and 2021.

pmc-13412492.title: Molecular Pathway and Regulatory Mechanism of the Saponin Biosynthesis in Sea Cucumber Apostichopus japonicus
pmc-13412492.creator: Pingzhe Jiang, Shan Gao, Yujun Liu, Zhong Chen, Liang Zhao, Zelong Zhao, Feifei Zhang, Yongjia Pan, Yao Xiao, Guohan Zhang, Jingwei Jiang, Zunchun Zhou
pmc-13412492.description: Sea cucumber Apostichopus japonicus is one of the few animals capable of synthesizing saponins, which are critical components of its nutritional quality and health-beneficial properties. However, the specific mechanism underlying saponin biosynthesis in sea cucumbers remains unclear despite previous investigations. This study aimed to characterize the molecular pathway and regulatory mechanism of saponin biosynthesis in A. japonicus.
